--- revoke_execute_on_models.sql
REVOKE EXECUTE ON MODEL MyModel, OtherModel FROM ROLE MyRole, OtherRole

--- AST
&ast.Revoke{
  Privilege: &ast.ExecutePrivilegeOnModel{
    Execute: 7,
    Names:   []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 24,
            NameEnd: 31,
            Name:    "MyModel",
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 33,
            NameEnd: 43,
            Name:    "OtherModel",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 54,
      NameEnd: 60,
      Name:    "MyRole",
    },
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 62,
      NameEnd: 71,
      Name:    "OtherRole",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE EXECUTE ON MODEL MyModel, OtherModel FROM ROLE MyRole, OtherRole
